text:
Iris: Quick thread — launch next Tue. We need a compact nurture that feels personalized but is easy to scale.
Sam - growth: Agreed. Proposal: route by signup signal + primary intent. Three segments: Integrations, Cost, Platform Eval.
Lina: How reliable are signals right now? product signup only sends utm_source sometimes.
Diego: Forms and cal pages include a `use_case` field. Product signup: fallback to utm_campaign, then "general".
Iris: Cool. Let's keep the first email identical (welcome + product tour), then branch on email #2 (benchmark narrative) and #3 (webinar invite).
Sam - growth: Draft cadence:
```
T0: Welcome (tour GIF + getting started links)
T+48h: Benchmark email (three slip-level metrics + PR-friendly one-pager)
T+5d: Webinar invite (30m demo + 15m live Q&A)
T+10d: Use-case playbook + CTA to trial or book demo
```
Lina: For benchmark email copy: keep two tones per segment — PM-friendly (impact/metrics) and Eng-friendly (link to repo/benchmarks).
Diego: I'll produce the short benchmark one-pager (single PDF) with charts: median p95 latency, cost per 1k tokens, and observed fault-recovery.
Sam - growth: Subject line experiments per segment. Example for Cost bucket: A: "How teams cut inference spend 3x" B: "Spend less on inference, keep the quality"
Iris: Add accessibility alt text to GIFs and plain-text fallbacks. Also we need two subject-line variants per segment for A/B.
Lina: Who owns seg mapping doc? I can make a small table mapping source -> bucket and example copy snippets.
Diego: I'll handle the GIF and the infra check for the demo environment.
LaunchBot: Reminder scheduled: submit final copy for review by 1754328400.
Sam - growth: I'll drop the copy draft here once done and ping design for creative assets.
Iris: One more ask  include a short pre-webinar survey link (2 questions) in the invite to route attendees into breakout topics.
Lina: Adding note: ensure we exclude trialing customers from generic nurture and route them to sales outreach.
Diego: FYI, webinar time should hit both NA morning and EU afternoon  propose 11:00 PT / 19:00 UTC.
Iris: Thanks all. Action items: Lina (seg doc + subject lines), Diego (gif + infra), Sam (copy drafts + set A/B), LaunchBot (review reminder). Reconvene here with drafts. :thumbsup:
